summary: Wrote 6 social posts (2 per platform) for the Momentum launch, grounded in the T2 messaging framework. Platforms: LinkedIn (professional, insight-first, ends with question/CTA), X/Twitter (hook-first, <280 chars each), Instagram (casual, emoji-friendly, visual-first framing with carousel recommendations). All posts use the energy-adaptive scheduling differentiator and avoid generic AI-powered claims.

posts_detail.linkedin_1: Introduce Momentum — problem/solution: 92% failure rate, rigid streaks punish humans, energy-adaptive scheduling
posts_detail.linkedin_2: Pattern-insights differentiator — data-led, cause-and-effect correlations (sleep → exercise), no generic AI claims
posts_detail.x_1: 278 chars — hook on 92% failure rate, contrasts binary streaks with Momentum's adaptive approach
posts_detail.x_2: 274 chars — keystone habit focus (2-3 habits) vs. habit hoarding (15 parallel trackers)
posts_detail.instagram_1: Energy-adaptive hero — casual tone, 3-panel carousel visual concept, encouraging CTA
posts_detail.instagram_2: Contrast with rigid apps — problem/solution carousel meme format, human-first language, anti-guilt framing
